# HSL

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A color in HSL (hue, saturation, lightness) format.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/hsl",
  "type": "HSLOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/hsl').par.h` (an input) and `op('/hsl').out.color` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.h`, `out.color`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `h` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `s` | `NumberField` | `0.5` |
| `l` | `NumberField` | `0.8` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs
